property_summary: For every admissible input (_feeRate <= 5000, _baseToken != address(0)), a successful call to initialize must persist the supplied base token so that c.flashFeeToken() equals _baseToken; the mutant drops the baseToken assignment, leaving flashFeeToken() at address(0) and violating the rule.
change_summary: Delete the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken remains address(0) after initialization.
